origins.neoorigins.water_mage.descriptio: He kaikawe wai e whakahaere ana i ngā ngaru me ngā awa whakaora. I te kāinga i roto i te moana, engari ka maroke i roto i nga whenua maroke.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_tidal_wave.d: Whakatere i tētahi kōwae wai ki mua, e hāpai ana i ngā kino e whā, ā, e akiaki ana i ngā hoariri. E rima ngā hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_healing_mist: Tukuna he ngaru whakaora e whakahoki mai ana i te 6 HP ki a koe me ngā kaitākaro tata. E toru ngā mana te utu. Tekau hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.name: Ngā kararehe wai
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.desc: Whakatika i raro i te wai mō te wā mutunga kore.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_swim_speed.d: He tere ake te kaukau i te mea noa.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_moisture_reg: Ka āta whakahoutia te hauora i a koe e ruku ana i te wai.
Tangohia te kino i roto i ngā koraha me ngā whenua maroke  te hau maroke e whakaiti i tō kaha.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.name: He ngoikore
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.desc: Tukuna he 25% iti iho te kino o te whawhai. E rere ana tō mana mā te wai, ehara i te uaua.
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.name: Kaihanga ahi
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.description: He kaikauwhau ahi e hurihuri ana i roto i te mura  e pupuhi ana i ngā pōro ahi, e pupuhi ana ki roto i te reinga, e tahu ana i te hunga e patu ana i a koe. Kāore e taea e te ahi te whara i a koe, engari ko te wai te whakangaromanga.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.name: Pahupahu
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.desc: Whakapā atu ki tētahi pupuhi o ngā pōro ahi iti e whā ki te aronga e titiro ana koe. E toru ngā mana te utu. E whā hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_inferno_burst: Tukuna he pupuhi ahi e whakangaro ana i ngā hoariri tata katoa. E toru ngā mana te utu. E waru hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_flame_cloak.d: Ka riro i ngā kaiwhaiwhai te 30% o te kino e tukuna ana e rātau hei utu ahi.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fire_immunity: E ārai ana i te ahi, i te awa, i te parekura o te magma. He mahana noa iho te awa.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_water_weaknes: Tangohia 1 kino ia hēkona i te wai, i te ua rānei.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.name: Te oumu ā-roto
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.descri: Ka tere ake te 50% o te matekai i te wera o roto.
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.name: Kaihanga rangi
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.description: He kaikawe rererangi tere e pupuhi ana i te hau, e huri ana i te hau o te nekehanga, e eke ana i nga ngaru ki te rangi. He māmā rite te hau, engari he ngoikore rite te rau.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_wind_charge.de: Whakaarahia he puhiko hau e waihanga ana i tētahi pupuhi i te pānga.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.name: Ko te hau hau
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.desc: Tukua he pupuhi hau e whakaputa ana i tētahi ngaru i runga i te pānga  ka hopu, ka hiki, ka huri i ngā mea e tata ana mō ngā hēkona e whā. E wha mana te utu.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.name: Te rerenga ki runga
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.descri: Whakarewahia koe ki te rangi i runga i te pou hau.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_no_fall_damage: Te Whakatūnga i runga i te Pouaka
Ka ārai te hau i tō hinganga  kāore koe e pāngia e te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.name: Ko te Zephyr
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.descrip: Ka kawea e ngā hau o muri tonu  neke 20% tere ake i te waewae.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.name: Te heke o te pare
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.desc: Me heke āta, me te mea kāore he pānga o te taumaha. Whakakorea mā te kī pūkenga ina hiahia koe ki te heke tere.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.name: Ko te anga pakaru
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.descri: -2 ngā ngākau (-4 HP mōrahi). Kāore te tinana hau i hangaia kia mau tonu.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.name: He ngawari te taumaha
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.descript: Tangohia te 50% atu o te whakahekenga  ka ngāwari rawa te hau ki a koe.
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.name: Te Kaitohutohu Tauhokohoko
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.descript: He kaiwhakaheke i ngā āpure taumaha e piko ana i te mokowā anō. Tonoa ngā hoariri ki roto i tētahi tūtohutanga whakangaro, pupuhi rānei i a rātou  engari ko tō tinana ake e kore e herea ki te whenua.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.name: He pai te taumaha
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.descr: Whakaarahia tētahi ao pōuri ka taka ki roto i tētahi poka pango i te pānga. Ko ngā mea e tata ana ki te pokapū, ka pāngia mō te whā hēkona. E wha mana te utu. 20 hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_repulse.de: Tukuna he ngaru pānga taumaha e pupuhi ana i ngā mea katoa e tata ana. E toru ngā mana te utu. E whā hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_levitation: Ka taea te huri: whakahee i te taumaha me te piki ake i runga i te whakahau (Levitation I). Whakakorea mā te taunoa  tahuri ki runga ki te kī pūkenga.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_no_fall_da: E kore e taea e koe te tango i te kino o te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_unmoored.d: Tangohia te 75% atu o te whakahekenga  ka māmā te whakarewa i a koe nā tō taumahatanga ngoikore.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.name: He ngoikore
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.desc: Tukuna he 25% iti iho te kino o te whawhai. Ko tō mana kei roto i te hopu, ehara i te whiu.
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.name: Kaitohutohu o te Pouri
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.descrip: He kaikawe atarangi e karanga ana i nga ao atarangi e huri ana, e hikoi ana i waenga i nga puna o te pouri. I te pō, he mea whakamate, engari ka tahuna e te rā tōu mana.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_or: Whakanohoia tētahi ao atarangi ki tōu wāhi e whakawhiwhi ana i te Pouri me te Matapo ki ngā hoariri e tata ana. Tae atu ki te 3 orbs e kaha ana i te wā kotahi. E toru ngā mana te utu. E rima ngā hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_st: Teleport ki te wāhi e titiro ana koe, tae noa ki te 24 wharenui atu. E rua ngā mana te utu. E whā hēkona ki muri.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_night_vis: Kia mārama te kite i roto i te pōuri katoa. Whakapā atu ki te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_cl: E kitea ana koe e ngā tinihanga i te 40% noa iho o to rātau whānuitanga noa iho.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_sunburn.d: Tangohia 1 kino ia hēkona i te rā tika.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_light_sen: Ko te 30% te puhoi ake  te marama o ngā mata e whara ana e whara ana i ō kanohi.
